name: fantasy
note: Rules for the /adventure character creator. Editable data, not code: a setting can ship its own. Lives inside src/ because the deploy rsyncs src/ only.

races.name: Human
races.blurb: Adaptable, ambitious, everywhere. Jack of all trades.

races.name: Elf
races.blurb: Quick and long-lived. Elves see the shot coming and step aside.

races.name: Dwarf
races.blurb: Stout, stubborn, and hard to kill.

races.name: Halfling
races.blurb: Small, lucky, and hard to notice.

races.name: Orc
races.blurb: Built for the front line. Dumb.

races.name: Tiefling
races.blurb: Horned and unwelcome anywhere. Talks its way in, then out again.

races.name: Lizardfolk
races.blurb: Cold-blooded and patient. Thick scales, and a longer memory.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.blurb: Classic warrior. A master of arms.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.blurb: Tracks, traps, and bows. At home in the wild.

classes.name: Bard
classes.blurb: Song, talk, and nerve. Wins the fights that never quite start.

classes.name: Wanderer
classes.note: Always available, for the especially unskilled.
